title: feat(spec): a comment's author is told which mentioned users will not be notified, and a mention added by editing notifies
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibxkM6EsYLMNr5Vc8zP _Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoCo2Sh8f9RPpXDLsaSokbvc)_ Fixes #27703 Clause-②: yes Metadata-protocol: added Skills-docs: none — a response-only answer member and an in-process listener, nothing a metadata author writes; the docs teach it here (`content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`, `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx`) Ruling-ref: 6523848208 ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：评论（`sys_comment`）的新建和编辑应答多了一个只读成员 `withheldMentions`，列出这次 @ 了、但被提及闸门扣下通知的人的 id（多半因为读不到评论或记录）；编辑评论时新加的 @ 现在也会通知，通知以编辑者为发起人。客户端 SDK 的 `CreateDataResult` / `UpdateDataResult` 同步声明这个键。 - 为什么改：以前闸门只在服务器日志里记一笔，作者以为对方已被通知，其实没有；编辑时加的 @ 谁也不通知。 - 风险与回滚：只告诉发起这次请求的人本人，只给 id、不给原因，不落库；谁能收到通知的判定没变。回滚即 revert 本 PR，不读这个键的客户端不受影响。 - 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts` 的 `writeCommentMentions`（更新时只判新增的 @）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的 `createData` / `updateData`、`packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts` 的 `onMentionsWithheld`。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts`，预期 28 条全绿。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes The `@mention` recipient gate withholds a notification from a mentioned user who cannot read the comment or its record. It only logged that, so the author believed the person had been told. As ruled (6523848208, letter A, disclosure accepted), the requester's own create and update answer now names who will not be notified, from the gate's own verdict: ids only, never the reason, never stored. **Transport.** No new path was built. The engine already hands every `after*` hook the caller's own options bag on `ctx.input.options` (the PHASE rule in `hook.zod.ts`: `buildDriverOptions` widens the bag and never strips a key), and `createData` / `updateData` already collect in-process listeners from it (`onFieldsDropped`, `onValidationAdvisory`). This PR adds one more listener of that family. - **Spec (`packages/spec`).** - `CreateDataResponseSchema` and `UpdateDataResponseSchema` declare an optional `withheldMentions: string[]`, with one shared description (withheld by the mention gate, response-only, ids only, filled only by a `sys_comment` write and only on the requester's own answer, omitted when empty, never stored). It is declared generically, the way `warnings` is, because the protocol types one create answer and one update answer for every object, not one per object. `CloneDataResponseSchema` does not get it: the ruling names create and update only. - `WriteObservabilityOptions` (`contracts/data-engine.ts`) declares `onMentionsWithheld?: (userIds: readonly string[]) => void`. Its docblock says the engine never calls it, that it reaches the mention writer on `ctx.input.options`, and that it never crosses the wire. `HookUpdateOptions` names it among the members it inherits. - `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` regenerated (`gen:docs`). - **plugin-audit.** - `mention-recipient-gate.ts`: `MentionGateInput.onWithheld(userId)` is optional. The gate's existing `withhold()` calls it for every withheld recipient that resolved to a user, whatever the reason. The reason stays in the log line. Who the gate admits is unchanged: the callback is called after the verdict and a throwing callback is swallowed. - `audit-writers.ts`: `writeCommentMentions` is registered on `afterUpdate` as well as `afterInsert`. On an update it judges only the entries the written row's `mentions` gained over `ctx.previous`, so a kept mention is never re-judged or re-notified. After the gate answers, it calls the write's own `onMentionsWithheld` once with the withheld ids (deduplicated, in the order named), and a throwing listener is logged and ignored. The `mentions` parse moved into a `parseCommentMentions` helper so both sides of the update read it one way. - On an edit, the actor is the editor (`ctx.session.userId`), who may be a parent-record editor rather than the author: they are named in the title (resolved from `sys_user` via `resolveActorSnapshot`) and are never notified themselves. A create keeps the comment's `author_id` / `author_name`. - **metadata-protocol.** `createData` and `updateData` pass `onMentionsWithheld` and answer `withheldMentions` omit-when-empty. The set is local to the request, so no other request's answer can carry it. - **client.** `CreateDataResult` and `UpdateDataResult` in `packages/client/src/index.ts` declare `withheldMentions?: string[]`, mirroring the two schemas. - **objectql.** `ENGINE_UPDATE_OPTION_KEYS` admits `onMentionsWithheld`, because `engine.update` refuses unknown option keys. `insert` has no such allowlist. The drift pin in `engine-unknown-option.test.ts` names the new member. - **Docs.** `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` (POST / PATCH) and `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx` (`WriteObservabilityOptions`, a new `onMentionsWithheld` section). - **Changeset.** `.changeset/27703-withheld-mentions-answer.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/client`, all `minor` (`Metadata-protocol: added` takes at least minor on every package the diff moves), with both declaration lines. **Requester-only and never stored, and how each is pinned.** - The listener exists only on the options of the request that wrote the comment. A nested write that a hook makes carries its own options. Pins: `protocol-withheld-mentions-answer.test.ts` "a nested write … adds nothing to the outer answer" and "each request answers only its own", and plugin-audit's "a comment written by a hook inside another write never reaches the outer write's listener". - Nothing is stored. `sys_comment` declares no such field, the stored row read back as system carries only what the author wrote, and CAROL (a reader of the thread) reads the same row with no verdict about BOB. Pins: plugin-audit "nothing is stored", and objectql "nothing is stored: the persisted row carries no member beyond what was written". - The listener is a function in an in-process bag. A function cannot be serialized, so no REST or SDK caller can pass one or receive one. The only thing on the wire is the answer member. ## Tests The first round ran on `9a38b6c0` (and `eb6b1469`, which differs only by a merge of `origin/main` touching no file of this diff). The patch round after the contract review (`be32a8da`, `51450e76`) changed the describe and docblock wording, added the client mirror and the editor-as-actor behaviour; its runs are listed as such below. - **New contract pins.** `packages/spec/src/api/write-answer-withheld-mentions.test.ts` covers four things. The member is accepted on both answers and an answer without it stays legal. Anything but an array of ids is refused (no per-user objects, no reason). The clone answer does not declare it. The listener type takes ids and may be absent. - **Transport, real engine + real protocol.** `packages/objectql/src/protocol-withheld-mentions-answer.test.ts` uses a real `ObjectQL` and the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`. The one stand-in is the writer, an `after*` hook. It pins five things. `createData` / `updateData` answer the hook's ids, deduplicated, and the answers conform. The key is absent when nothing was reported. Nothing is persisted. A nested write's report never reaches the outer answer. A second request is not told the first one's ids. - **The verdict, real gate.** `mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts` runs the kernel, SQLite, `AuditPlugin` and the real recipient gate. It gains 11 cases: - a create tells its own listener the withheld ids, in the order named, while the reader is still notified; - a user named by email is reported by id, once; - the listener is never called when nobody is withheld, for the author, for an unknown address or for an audience expansion; - nothing is stored, and a reader of the thread sees nothing about anyone else; - a hook's nested comment never reaches the outer listener; - an edit that adds mentions notifies the new reader and reports only the withheld new ones; - a kept mention is not re-judged, and a body-only edit judges nothing; - an editor who is not the author (CAROL edits ALICE's comment) is the actor: ALICE is notified, CAROL is not, the event's `actorId` is CAROL and the title names her (patch round); - a throwing listener breaks neither the write nor the notification; - the gate's `onWithheld` gets ids only (none for an unknown email or a `role:` entry); - a throwing `onWithheld` changes no verdict. - **An existing pin updated as a consequence of the change.** `audit-writers.test.ts` "emits only to the recipients the gate admits" pinned the gate input exactly. It now also expects `onWithheld: expect.any(Function)`. - `engine-unknown-option.test.ts`: `onMentionsWithheld` passes on `update`, and the drift pin names it.
Package suites and typecheck - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test`: Test Files 67/67, Tests 1089/1089 (the first run caught the `audit-writers.test.ts` pin above, which was then fixed, and the file re-ran at 118/118). - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 284 passed, 4 skipped; Tests 21859 passed, 26 skipped. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: Test Files 495/495, Tests 9631/9631. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 757/757, Tests 22520 passed, 1 todo. - `typecheck` for `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/objectql`: all exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0), including each package's `check:test-typecheck`. - Patch round, on `51450e76`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run` Test Files 67/67, Tests 1090/1090; `tsc --noEmit` for `@objectstack/client` and `@objectstack/plugin-audit` exit 0; the spec contract test 7/7; the objectql transport and option tests 32/32. - On `9a38b6c0`: the spec contract tests 16/16, the objectql transport and option tests 32/32, and plugin-audit's gate integration and `audit-writers.test.ts` 145/145.
Ablations (one-shot, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored to blob == HEAD) | # | Mutation | Expected | Observed | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | A1 | writer: `onMentionsWithheld(withheld);` replaced by a no-op | listener pins red | 4 failed / 27 (create, email, both edit cases) | | A1b | writer: the update's added-only filter removed | edit pins red | 2 failed / 27 (both edit cases) | | A1c | writer: the `afterUpdate` registration deleted | added-mention pin red | 1 failed / 27 | | A2 | `createData`: answer key renamed (`ablatedA2`); metadata-protocol rebuilt, marker proven in `dist/` | transport pins red | 2 failed / 7; restore leg rebuilt, marker proven absent, 7/7 | | A3 | `createData`: the per-request set hoisted to a process-wide one; rebuilt, marker proven in `dist/` | per-request pins red | 3 failed / 7 (control, nested, second-request); restore leg rebuilt, absent, 7/7 | | A4 | writer (patch round): the edit's actor reverted to `row.author_id` | editor pin red | 1 failed / 28 (the editor case) | plugin-audit imports `AuditPlugin` from source, so A1–A1c needed no build. The objectql transport test resolves `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` through `dist/`, so A2 and A3 rebuilt it on both legs and checked them with `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`.
## Acceptance notes - **Entries that resolve to no id are not listed.** `withheldMentions` holds the ids the gate judged. A token without `@` is taken as an id as written, so an id that names no user is judged, withheld, and listed like any other. A mention of an unknown email, or an audience expansion (`role:` / `team:` / `owner_of:`), resolves to no id and is withheld with nothing to give back. The picker only offers existing users, so the console does not produce these. - **Failures outside the gate's verdict are not reported.** These are: no `messaging` service composed, no gate composed (fail closed, warned once), the gate itself throwing, and a `messaging.emit` failing for an admitted user. The ruling scopes the member to the gate's withheld verdicts, and each of these failures is logged at `warn` as before. - **Batch, clone and flow writes do not answer it.** Only `createData` and `updateData` pass the listener, as ruled. A comment created through `createManyData` / `batchData`, cloned, or written by a flow still notifies its readers and logs what it withheld. Its caller is not told. - **The edit's actor.** On an edit, the editor is the actor, not the comment's author: `sys_comment` admits an edit by the author or by a holder of EDIT on the parent record, so the editor may not be the author. The editor is never notified and is named in the title; the author, if mentioned, is notified like anyone else. - **The ui half** (read `withheldMentions` in the three Discussion write callbacks, name the users in one sentence, mention chips) is the seat's follow-up `domain:ui` card once this key is on `main`. ## Verification **Patch round, head `51450e76`.** Re-derived against the patched diff: the same 113 families. All 113 re-ran on `51450e76`, each with stdin from `/dev/null` and its exit code recorded before any pipe, reconciled with `--ran`: **113 derived, 112 run, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun, 0 red.** The one NOT MEASURED is `spec check:skill-examples` (exit 3, client SDK dist prerequisite), CI's. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` is green after `gen:docs` regenerated `protocol.mdx` for the new describe wording. **First round, head `9a38b6c0`.** Gates were derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against this diff (113 families). Each ran with stdin from `/dev/null`, and each exit code was recorded before any pipe. The record is reconciled with `--ran`: **113 derived, 110 run, 3 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun, 0 red.** - NOT MEASURED, prerequisite not met (exit 3, the gate refusing before it reads anything). These are CI's: - `check:i18n` needs the CLI's build closure; - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs a whole-repo `pnpm build`; - `spec check:skill-examples` needs the client SDK dist. - `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 because its pinned positive control `621a4876` was not in this shallow clone. After fetching that one commit it re-ran green (48 cases), and the record carries the re-run. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artefacts up to date on `9a38b6c0`, after a rebuild of the merged source. The two regenerated artefacts are `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` and `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (two response keys). - Full dogfood: not owed (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm). - The full farm is CI's. The PR's check-runs are the evidence for every family outside the derived set. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01L9qibxkM6EsYLMNr5Vc8zP)_
